_readme: Declared dependency on GitHub Actions secrets. GitHub substitutes the empty string for a secret that does not exist, so an unprovisioned reference fails deep inside a scheduled run instead of at authoring time. tests/invariants/workflow-secret-provisioning.spec.ts pins this file against the workflows. provisioned=false means the workflows referencing it cannot do their credentialed work until an operator provisions it in the listed scope. `environments` lists the protected GitHub environments a workflow's security rests on: GitHub creates an environment a job names on its first use, with no protection rules, so a missing or unprotected environment does not fail the job. Each entry is the operator check of the repository settings the workflow cannot verify; provisioned=false means it has not been set up yet.

ARIA_GH_APP_ID.why: used by aria-agent-executor.yml, aria-auto-cycle.yml, aria-daily-report.yml, aria-merge-runner.yml, aria-readiness-claim.yml, dataflow-integrity-watchdog.yml, finding-closure-reconcile.yml, finding-state-sweep.yml — GitHub App id for the installation-token mint (docs/runbooks/aria-github-app-setup.md)

ARIA_GH_APP_INSTALLATION_ID.why: used by aria-agent-executor.yml, aria-auto-cycle.yml, aria-daily-report.yml, aria-merge-runner.yml, aria-readiness-claim.yml, dataflow-integrity-watchdog.yml, finding-closure-reconcile.yml, finding-state-sweep.yml — the GitHub App installation id for the enterprise token lease the readiness claim family attests; the lane fails closed (ARIA_REQUIRE_MODE_A) without it; aria-merge-runner.yml mints its merge token from it, and the delivering steps of aria-auto-cycle.yml and aria-agent-executor.yml mint the installation token that opens every ARIA PR (Mode A only, ARIA-HIGH-208); every self-hosted lane's hosted runner-preflight (.github/actions/require-self-hosted-runner) mints a token with administration:read only, to read the repository's runner roster, and fails by name without it

ARIA_GH_APP_PRIVATE_KEY.why: used by aria-agent-executor.yml, aria-auto-cycle.yml, aria-daily-report.yml, aria-merge-runner.yml, aria-readiness-claim.yml, dataflow-integrity-watchdog.yml, finding-closure-reconcile.yml, finding-state-sweep.yml — GitHub App private key, the full PEM content (BEGIN and END lines included); consuming steps materialize it into an ephemeral 0600 file under RUNNER_TEMP, outside the workspace — hosted runners have no operator key path, and the self-hosted delivering steps (ARIA-HIGH-208) take the key from this one secret rather than from a host file

P0: the dev/CI key of Suderra-OS scripts/gen-dev-keys.sh. Until it is provisioned every agent-v* release stops at the sign job.

edge-release.why: ADR-048 DEC-3.9 / DEC-20: the edge-release signing key reaches only the reviewed sign-release-statement job of an agent-v* tag. Operator check before the first agent-v* tag: Settings > Environments > edge-release exists; Required reviewers is on with at least one reviewer other than the tag author (prevent self-review); Deployment branches and tags is 'Selected branches and tags' with only the tag rule agent-v*; the secret EDGE_RELEASE_SIGNING_KEY and the variable EDGE_RELEASE_KEYID are set on this environment; and no repository-level or organization-level secret named EDGE_RELEASE_SIGNING_KEY exists (it would be readable by every workflow of the repository). Set provisioned to true, and the secret's scope to 'environment: edge-release', only after all of these hold.
